newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to attend May 28 EU summit at the Hague.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to attend May 28 EU summit at the Hague.

text.p: President Bill Clinton will visit the Netherlands on May 28 to participate in a European Union summit and mark the 50th anniversary of the post-Second World War Marshall Plan, the White House said on Monday.
No other details of Clinton's trip were announced, but a White House official said the EU summit and Marshall Plan commemoration would take place at the Hague.
The official, who asked not to be identified, said Clinton might also visit other European countries during the trip, but that this had not yet been decided.
The Marshall Plan was a $12 billion U.S. aid programme for the post-war reconstruction of Europe. It was named for Gen. George Marshall, President Harry Truman's secretary of state.
